wake.description: a scheduled time to come back to something
wake.$comment: A wake carries no patch to apply when it fires: a rule's produce already writes the entity it matched. Patching a wake's target declaratively would need a rule that names that target.

at.description: when it is next due; absent once a one-shot has fired, or once a recurrence has ended

target.description: what the wake is about; when absent, the entity carrying it

note.description: a line for whoever is woken: why the wake was set

every.description: how it recurs: a duration (30m, 2h, 1d), five cron fields (0 9 * * 1-5), or @hourly/@daily/@weekly/@monthly; a cron line may end with an IANA time zone (0 9 * * 1-5 America/New_York), otherwise UTC
